name: Shiva 'Persinger Session' (7 chirp applications, counter-clockwise ring)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva software, launcher persinger_batch); Murphy attributes the session to M.A. Persinger, but no Persinger paper describing it has been found
summary: Murphy's Shiva session that he says Persinger 'developed for training in psi skills' and that 'enhances whatever spiritual technique a person works with': seven chirp applications with silences in between, stepping counter-clockwise around an 8-position ring, about 43 minutes.
setting: Dark, quiet room. Murphy: 'Don't do spiritual practices or psychic exercises during Shiva Sessions ... Daydreaming is better than meditation.' For perception during the session he advises geomagnetic quiet (K 0-2).
schedule: Weekly at most. For skill training Murphy advises running it when the K-index is 4 ('unsettled') and starting mental or psychic exercises two days later, for three days (elsewhere: practise 3-5 days after).
notes: One coil per Shiva position (Shiva uses a like-polarity pair at each): the first over the left frontal area (Fp1), then FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2, stepping counter-clockwise seen from above, so front to back on the left and back to front on the right; no coils above the nose, directly above the ears or above the bony ridge at the back of the head. Murphy gives only the structure ('seven unique applications of the chirp signal with silent sections in between. The signals follow the standard counterclockwise rotation. The session is about 43 minutes long'); the 2011 version of the page (launcher persinger_batch.bat) has the same sentences without the 43-min figure, and his session-length page gives 40 to 45 min for this and the Published Studies session. No source gives the length of an application, a silence or a coil step, and no Persinger paper with a seven-application chirp batch is known, so the split into 7 x 5 min with 80-s silences is a project choice. The chirp template is proprietary. Murphy says it 'does not change in tone, but rather has longer and longer gaps between sections of the signal as they travel around your head', so a steady 40 Hz carrier is used and the coil-to-coil timing supplies the gaps; any modulation inside the original is not reproduced. The project's 'modulated 40 Hz' signal (pm) has no built-in silence, and seven blocks plus six separate silent phases would exceed the 12-phase limit, so it is not used here (the clockwise copy, murphy-shiva-retro-clockwise, uses the same timing). Each block has its own rising dwell ramp, so all seven differ (a project assignment). Blocks 1-6 step +2 ms per coil starting at 10, 12 ... 20 ms; block 1 is Murphy's lecture example, 10 to 20 ms. Block 7 uses the lab Octopus ramp of +20 ms per position, reset after the longest (20 to 160 ms; the 20-ms changes follow Richards 2002, the 20-ms start is a project choice). Murphy's speed statements disagree and Shiva's step tables are unpublished: in 2007 'around the same speed' as the 25-ms binding factor (about 5 turns a second), in the lecture an illustrative 10, 12 ... 20 ms per coil, and since 2008 'around 9 times per second', with the signal divided 'into eight segments, which change in length by a few milliseconds each time'. Blocks 1-6 here turn about 8.3 down to 5 times a second and block 7 about 1.4 times; their six-value lecture ramps restart every six coils instead of lining up with Shiva's eight segments (kept to match the project's other Shiva sessions). The lab Octopus used about 1-10 uT. The vendor says to start at 50% volume and raise it each session (up to 92%), so start low here and increase gradually. The psi and spiritual claims rest on Persinger-lab studies and testimonials, such as the Swiss DeepFocus report, a two-page testimonial by a Shiva coaching business: it reports about 400 test sessions in Germany and Switzerland, about 100 people with five or more sessions, in most cases with the Persinger Session, and asserts EEG findings without data, methods or controls (Murphy's blog calls it an independent replication; it is not one). Independent double-blind tests of Persinger-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Weekly at most; do not run it back to back with another session (a testimonial that did so says it 'wasn't advised'). Stop on distress; not for people with epilepsy. Changed in this revision: origin, page history, the speed statements and the DeepFocus description in these notes; the phases are unchanged.

phases.name: Chirp 1 of 7 (10 to 20 ms per coil), then 80 s silence
Chirp 2 of 7 (12 to 22 ms per coil), then 80 s silence
Chirp 3 of 7 (14 to 24 ms per coil), then 80 s silence
Chirp 4 of 7 (16 to 26 ms per coil), then 80 s silence
Chirp 5 of 7 (18 to 28 ms per coil), then 80 s silence
Chirp 6 of 7 (20 to 30 ms per coil), then 80 s silence
Chirp 7 of 7 (20 to 160 ms per coil, +20 ms, Octopus ramp)
